```yaml
architecture:
  style: clean-architecture
  layers:
    - name: domain
      kind: domain
      directories:
        - src/domain/**
      file_patterns:
        - "src/domain/**/*.ts"
      roles:
        - entity
        - value-object
        - repository-interface
    - name: application
      kind: application
      directories:
        - src/application/**
      file_patterns:
        - "src/application/**/*.ts"
      roles:
        - use-case
        - dto
        - application-service
    - name: presentation
      kind: presentation
      directories:
        - src/presentation/**
      file_patterns:
        - "src/presentation/**/*.ts"
      roles:
        - controller
        - middleware
    - name: infrastructure
      kind: infrastructure
      directories:
        - src/infrastructure/**
      file_patterns:
        - "src/infrastructure/**/*.ts"
      roles:
        - repository-impl
        - orm-entity
    - name: main
      kind: infrastructure
      directories:
        - src/main/**
      file_patterns:
        - "src/main/**/*.ts"
      roles:
        - factory
default_exclude_paths:
  - "node_modules/**"
  - "dist/**"
  - "**/*.spec.ts"
  - "**/*.test.ts"
```
